hook: A $22 billion deal gives Fox 70% of free streaming.

sections.voiceover: A $22 billion deal gives Fox 70% of free streaming.
b_roll: Motion graphic showing Fox logo alongside 70 percent market share figure

sections.voiceover: In San Jose, Newsmax sued to block Fox Corp.'s $22 billion Roku deal. The Department of Justice cleared the acquisition in November. Where will rivals go if Fox controls 70% of streaming?
b_roll: Federal court document graphic for San Jose antitrust filing
Department of Justice official seal graphic
Market breakdown diagram highlighting independent networks

sections.voiceover: Except Fox promised regulators that Roku will operate as an open platform.
b_roll: Digital graphic depicting open platform regulatory commitments

sections.voiceover: The lawsuit alleges that combining Fox and Roku creates an unlawful monopoly. Newsmax claims the deal hands Fox 70% of free ad-supported TV.
b_roll: Bar chart showing 70 percent FAST market concentration
Diagram showing media distribution control over competing channels

sections.voiceover: San Jose federal court now decides this $22 billion merger.
b_roll: San Jose federal courthouse outline graphic with $22 billion figure
